title: Investigation of Deep-Learning-Driven Identification of Multiple Sclerosis Patients Based on Susceptibility-Weighted Images Using Relevance Analysis.
summary: Deep-learning analysis of susceptibility-weighted MRI identified multiple-sclerosis patients and evaluated the image features supporting classification against clinical labels. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network with voxel-attribution methods
organization: University Hospital Jena; Michael-Stifel-Center for Data-Driven and Simulation Science Jena

evidence.tested: Deep-learning analysis of susceptibility-weighted MRI identified multiple-sclerosis patients and evaluated the image features supporting classification against clinical labels.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed study does not establish validation or benefit beyond its reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: A convolutional neural network classified multiple sclerosis from susceptibility-weighted MRI; voxel-attribution methods examined image regions behind predictions.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
